change: Raise a private non-OSError deadline exception through device-probe retry and GPU supervision; translate to TimeoutError only after unwinding and cleanup. Existing Manager code unchanged.
reason: A bare TimeoutError is an OSError. The device busy/probe retry branch could swallow it and continue queuing after a one-shot timer; the earlier post-return flag covered supervisor failures but not this continuing loop.
